attributes.name: Arrow Catching Studded Leather
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1, or 3 if it is also Ranged Combat damage.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if you are proficient with light armors, bury this card instead.

If you are proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armors Shield of Fire Resistance (Adventure Deck 1), Arrow Catching Studded Leather (AD 2), Deathbane Shield (AD 2), Spiny Shield (AD 3), Reflecting Shield (AD 4), Winged Shield (AD 5), and Entropy Shield (AD 6), and the loot Snakeskin Tunic (AD 2), add the following text: “If you are proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.”
corrections.issue: Should all shields with the Magic trait let you recharge them when you reset your hand?
